newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Select blue chips prop up Manila index at close.
newsitem.headline: Select blue chips prop up Manila index at close.

text.p: The Philippine equities market ended stronger on Monday as select blue chips boosted Manila's main index, traders said.

"It was a bit of a surprise as people were expecting a downtrend during the Lenten season. Some people saw the opportunity to accumulate," said Juan Trinidad, sales manager at DBS Securities Phils Inc.
Value turnover was thin at 1.859 billion pesos.

"People went bargain-hunting in anticipation of the buying after the Lenten season although there is still some concern on what the Fed would decide on concerning interest rates," said Jose Ricardo Garcia, Diversified Securities Inc executive vice-president.
Except for mining and finance issues, all other sub-indices rose. In the broad market, there were 58 gainers, 64 losers and 70 issues unchanged.
Blue chips led by Pilipino Telephone Corp, Philippine National Bank and Manila Electric Co enhanced the market's main barometer.
The market disregarded Philipine Long Distance Telephone Co's fall in New York as the issue gained 45 pesos to 1,595 pesos at the end of session.
Trinidad said the market's movement may take a holding pattern on Tuesday with resistance for the week pegged at 3,250.
